name: TensorFold PR #3586 tensor parallelism + B70 prefix attention kernel
notes: Branch tp2-attn-prefix, commit 2286abc0c. Built with Zig 0.17.0 and ocloc 26.05 plus a one-line local change that drops a 128-GRF build flag for Gemma 4 kernels. Not merged upstream.
summary: TensorFold upstream PR #3586 (--tp 2, open, by supernovae) at 480167c75 with one commit on top: the opt-in XPU_ATTN_PREF=256 prefix decode attention kernel. Drafted output equals serial output; tokens differ from stock TensorFold at depth.
